# Filter gizmo source and attribution

The portable [filter gizmo adapter](../../native/wasm/browser_filter_gizmo.cpp) adapts arithmetic and interaction rules from [ImGuizmo at commit 18cef5e031d8c6973d80284c67f60549fafd78c1](https://github.com/CedricGuillemet/ImGuizmo/blob/18cef5e031d8c6973d80284c67f60549fafd78c1/ImGuizmo.cpp). The exact reviewed source is retained in the [Windows target capture](../../reference/targets/windows-r0-20261012-02/source/third_party/ImGuizmo/ImGuizmo.cpp).

Adapted rules include perspective camera rays, constrained translation/rotation/scaling, signed snapping, and local scaling. Desktop volume composition/decomposition and parameter rules come from the captured [SplatView viewport tools](../../reference/targets/windows-r0-20261012-02/source/src/viewport_tools.cpp). The adapter replaces ImGui drawing and process-global widget state with fixed-size C++ value operations and CSS-space drawing records; the web UI renders those records as SVG. Scene data, selection masks, Preview, Confirm, history and gesture ownership remain in the existing SplatView controllers.

ImGuizmo is licensed under MIT, copyright 2016 Cedric Guillemet. The full notice is included in the adapter source and [the distributed license](../../public/licenses/ImGuizmo-MIT.txt), copied from the [captured license](../../reference/targets/windows-r0-20261012-02/source/third_party/ImGuizmo/LICENSE). The distribution manifest includes that license as a runtime asset. The SVG renderer and camera bridge do not introduce an ImGui dependency.

This attribution identifies this adaptation. Existing [PlayCanvas references](PLAYCANVAS_REFERENCES.md) remain documented separately.

The general [transform gizmo interface](../../native/wasm/browser_transform_gizmo.hpp) uses the same adapted ray, hit-test, constraint and snapping code in the shared adapter. Its widget frame is independent of the scene transform; C++ returns both the GPU matrix and the row-major delta used by the manual transform command. The [camera bridge](../../src/input/transformGizmo.ts) packs those fixed interfaces and retains detached press state.

Numeric composition and per-Gaussian baking use the pinned portable [processing kernels](../../native/upstream/splatview/src/core/processing_kernels.cpp), with controls and Flip presets from the captured [desktop processing UI](../../reference/targets/windows-r0-20261012-02/source/src/processing_ui.cpp). The [native transform math](../../native/wasm/browser_transform_math.cpp) retains the portable quaternion, pivot and affine arithmetic; the [cooperative session](../../native/wasm/browser_transform_session.cpp) applies the main transform and each Flip in desktop order. This extension shares the existing full ImGuizmo MIT notice and introduces no additional third-party runtime dependency.
